company: Rio Tinto Limited and Rio Tinto plc

associates.clause: (e) seek clearance in accordance with section 14 prior to any proposed Dealing in Rio Tinto Securities by a PCA, other than a Dealing excluded by section 10.
associates.reasoning: The PCA definition expressly captures a spouse, civil partner, dependent children, a household relative, and any company, trust, partnership or entity managed by, controlled by, set up for the benefit of, or economically equivalent to the PDMR or a family member, and section 13 makes the PDMR responsible for their PCAs' clearance and notification. The associate regime attaches only to PDMRs, not to Rio Tinto Personnel generally.

tiers.tier_name: Rio Tinto Personnel (all employees, directors and officers, contractors and secondees)

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: Certain restrictions detailed in this Policy apply only to Restricted Persons, Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), and the Persons Closely Associated (PCA) with the PDMRs.
findings.reasoning: The hedging ban in section 11 is directed only at Permanent Restricted Persons (and only at unvested or still-restricted plan securities), and the derivative ban in section 12.3 applies only to PDMRs, so ordinary Rio Tinto Personnel are bound on this activity by nothing beyond the insider dealing prohibition in section 5.1.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: Certain restrictions detailed in this Policy apply only to Restricted Persons, Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), and the Persons Closely Associated (PCA) with the PDMRs.
findings.reasoning: No clearance regime, closed period or hedging prohibition binds unrestricted Rio Tinto Personnel; the clearance obligation in section 14.1 reaches only Permanent and Project Restricted Persons, leaving only the insider dealing prohibition.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: Certain restrictions detailed in this Policy apply only to Restricted Persons, Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), and the Persons Closely Associated (PCA) with the PDMRs.
findings.reasoning: Granting security is a Dealing under the definition, but for unrestricted personnel the only operative rule about Dealing is the insider dealing prohibition in section 5.1; no clause requires clearance or notification from this tier.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: Certain restrictions detailed in this Policy apply only to Restricted Persons, Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), and the Persons Closely Associated (PCA) with the PDMRs.
findings.reasoning: The margin lending and secured financing prohibition in section 12.3(d) is expressly confined to PDMRs, so nothing in the Policy addresses secured borrowing by ordinary Rio Tinto Personnel.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: Certain restrictions detailed in this Policy apply only to Restricted Persons, Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), and the Persons Closely Associated (PCA) with the PDMRs.
findings.reasoning: Neither the derivative prohibition nor the secured financing prohibition in section 12.3 extends beyond PDMRs, and no clearance regime applies to this tier.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: Certain restrictions detailed in this Policy apply only to Restricted Persons, Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), and the Persons Closely Associated (PCA) with the PDMRs.
findings.reasoning: Securities lending is nowhere named, and although a title transfer would be a Dealing, the only Dealing rule binding this tier is the insider dealing prohibition.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: Certain restrictions detailed in this Policy apply only to Restricted Persons, Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities (PDMRs), and the Persons Closely Associated (PCA) with the PDMRs.
findings.reasoning: The section 10 carve-out for a disposal resulting from a secured lender exercising its rights is framed for Restricted Persons; unrestricted personnel are subject to no closed period or clearance requirement that a forced sale could breach.

tiers.tier_name: PDMRs (Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities, including Key Management Personnel), who are also Permanent Restricted Persons

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: PDMRs are prohibited from undertaking any of the following Dealings with respect to Rio Tinto Securities: (a) Dealing in derivative products issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities;
findings.definition: (e) entering into a transaction the economic outcome of which is dependent upon the price of a Rio Tinto Security, including but not limited to a transaction which has the effect of limiting the economic risk of holding a Rio Tinto Security;
findings.reasoning: A cash-settled collar, put or swap is a derivative product issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities and is a Dealing under limb (e) of the Dealing definition, so section 12.3(a) bans it outright for PDMRs regardless of clearance or closed periods.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: PDMRs are prohibited from undertaking any of the following Dealings with respect to Rio Tinto Securities: (a) Dealing in derivative products issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities;
findings.definition: (e) entering into a transaction the economic outcome of which is dependent upon the price of a Rio Tinto Security, including but not limited to a transaction which has the effect of limiting the economic risk of holding a Rio Tinto Security;
findings.reasoning: A physically settled collar or put is equally a derivative product over Rio Tinto Securities and so falls within the flat prohibition in section 12.3(a); the eventual disposal would in any event require clearance under section 14.1.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: (d) entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.definition: using as security, or otherwise granting a charge, lien or other encumbrance;
findings.reasoning: Granting security is expressly a Dealing under limb (c) of the Dealing definition, and section 12.3(d) prohibits PDMRs from entering into any secure financing arrangement in respect of Rio Tinto Securities, which is what a pledge or mortgage of the shares gives effect to. A bare encumbrance not securing financing would at minimum be a Dealing requiring prior written clearance under section 14.1.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: (d) entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.definition: (h) entering into any margin lending, derivative contract or other secured financial arrangement pursuant to which a charge is granted over the Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: Section 12.3(d) prohibits PDMRs from margin lending and from any other secure financing arrangement in respect of Rio Tinto Securities, which captures a margin loan or any loan secured over the shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: (d) entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.definition: (h) entering into any margin lending, derivative contract or other secured financial arrangement pursuant to which a charge is granted over the Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: Section 12.3(d) is not confined to charges over the shares themselves: it bans secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities generally, and the collar or put that would be charged is itself prohibited by section 12.3(a).

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: Permanent Restricted Persons and Project Restricted Persons are required to seek clearance prior to any proposed Dealing in Rio Tinto Securities, other than a Dealing excluded by section 10.
findings.definition: Dealing in Securities covers a wide range of transactions affecting the title or interest in those securities including: (a) acquisition or disposal;
findings.section: 14.1; definition of Deal, Dealing in section 16
findings.reasoning: A title-transfer securities loan is not named, but it is a transaction affecting title and so a Dealing, which for a PDMR (who is a Permanent Restricted Person) requires prior written clearance under section 14.1 and is barred during Closed Periods under section 12.1. It is not one of the section 10 exclusions.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: (f) a disposal of Rio Tinto Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.
findings.reasoning: Section 10 excludes the listed Dealings from the operation of the Policy and states they may be undertaken by Restricted Persons at any time without prior written clearance, subject only to the insider dealing prohibition; a secured lender's enforcement sale is limb (f), so a closed period does not stop it.
